summary.zh: 酸甜咸鲜的泰国国民炒粉，一口锅气的街头传奇。
summary.en: Sweet-sour-salty wok-fried rice noodles — Thailand's legendary street food.

ingredients.zh: 鲜虾 8 只或鸡胸肉 150 克
豆芽 1 把、韭菜段 1 把
ingredients.en: A handful each of bean sprouts and chives

ingredients.zh: 鱼露 2 大勺、棕榈糖 2 大勺
ingredients.en: 2 tbsp each fish sauce and palm sugar

ingredients.zh: 碎花生、青柠角、辣椒粉（上桌用）
ingredients.en: Crushed peanuts, lime wedges, chili flakes to serve

steps.zh: 干河粉用温水泡 30 分钟至柔软有弹性，沥干备用（不要泡烂）。
steps.en: Soak rice sticks in warm water 30 minutes until pliable but still firm; drain well.

steps.zh: 罗望子酱、鱼露、棕榈糖加 2 大勺水煮成 Pad Thai 酱汁。
steps.en: Simmer tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar with 2 tbsp water into the Pad Thai sauce.

steps.zh: 大火热油，下虾或鸡肉炒至变色，拨到锅边。
steps.en: Over high heat, fry prawns or chicken until just cooked; push to the side of the wok.

steps.zh: 空出的位置打入鸡蛋炒散，与肉混合。
steps.en: Crack eggs into the empty space, scramble, then combine with the meat.

steps.zh: 下河粉和酱汁，大火快炒，沿锅边淋少许水帮助软化，炒至汤汁收干。
steps.en: Add noodles and sauce; stir-fry on high, splashing water around the wok edge until the sauce is absorbed.

steps.zh: 最后下豆芽韭菜翻炒 10 秒出锅，配花生碎、青柠角、辣椒粉上桌。
steps.en: Toss in sprouts and chives for 10 seconds. Serve with peanuts, lime and chili flakes.

tips.zh: 河粉宁可泡得偏硬，炒制时会继续吸水变软。
tips.en: Under-soak rather than over-soak — noodles soften further in the wok.

tips.zh: 全程大火快炒，2 分钟内完成，才有街头锅气。
tips.en: Keep the heat high and finish within 2 minutes for true street-style wok hei.

tips.zh: 豆芽韭菜最后放，保持脆嫩口感。
tips.en: Add sprouts and chives at the very end to stay crisp.

failChecks.zh: 河粉糊成一团：泡太久或炒太久，下次缩短浸泡时间并加快手速。
failChecks.en: Noodles clumped into mush? Over-soaked or over-fried — soak less, move faster.

failChecks.zh: 太酸或太咸：罗望子与鱼露比例失衡，用棕榈糖回调平衡。
failChecks.en: Too sour or salty? Rebalance with more palm sugar.

failChecks.zh: 粉太干：泡得不够或酱汁太少，沿锅边补少量热水。
failChecks.en: Too dry? Splash hot water around the wok while frying.

culturalStory.zh: Pad Thai 的诞生与民族主义有关：1930 年代，泰国总理銮披汶为推动国家认同与大米出口（减少国内米粉消耗的说法流传甚广），向全国推广这道用泰式调料炒制的中式粿条。它融合了中国炒粉技法与泰国酸甜调味，如今是全球知名度最高的泰国菜，也是曼谷街头永远排队的那一口锅气。
culturalStory.en: Pad Thai was born of nationalism: in the 1930s, Prime Minister Plaek Phibunsongkhram promoted this Chinese-style noodle stir-fried with Thai seasonings to build national identity. Blending Chinese wok technique with Thai sweet-sour balance, it is now the world's best-known Thai dish — and the wok-fried aroma of Bangkok's streets.
